premise: In the long night Robot turns the beacon off to save power, but the plain still glows; Astronomer shows him the Earth, shining like a lamp.
inspiration: The old man-in-the-moon rhymes, turned around: from the Moon, it's the Earth that lights the night.
lesson: Someone far away can still light your way.
learning: Earthshine: sunlight bouncing off the Earth softly lights the Moon's night.

en-US.title: Who Left the Light On?
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall 14s} The long Moon night had begun. {beacon:enter} Out on the plain, the beacon {beacon:live hold} was shining. {robot:enter} Robot had one job: save power. {robot:go to beacon} {robot:face happy} {sfx:click} Click. {beacon:live resume} He switched the beacon off. [whispers] Darkness. Except… it wasn't quite dark. The grey plain still glowed, soft and silvery-blue. {robot:face surprised} [curious] Who left the light on? Robot checked every switch. Off. Off. Off. {robot:shake} {astronomer:enter} Astronomer laughed. Look up, she said. {astronomer:live hold} She raised her binoculars. There hung the Earth, big and blue. Sunlight bounces off the Earth and lands on us, she said. It's called earthshine. {canvas:milkyway 12s} {robot:face happy} Robot waved at the Earth. Thank you for the light! {pilot:enter} {pilot:face happy} Pilot waved too. And just in case the Earth wanted to see them back, {beacon:live hold} Robot switched the beacon on again.

es-ES.title: ¿Quién ha dejado la luz puesta?
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall 14s} Había empezado la larga noche lunar. {beacon:enter} En la llanura, la baliza {beacon:live hold} brillaba. {robot:enter} Robot tenía una tarea: ahorrar energía. {robot:go to beacon} {robot:face happy} {sfx:click} Clic. {beacon:live resume} Apagó la baliza. [whispers] Oscuridad. Aunque… no estaba del todo oscuro. La llanura gris seguía brillando, suave, de un azul plateado. {robot:face surprised} [curious] ¿Quién se ha dejado la luz encendida? Robot revisó todos los interruptores. Apagado. Apagado. Apagado. {robot:shake} {astronomer:enter} Astrónoma se rio. Mira arriba, dijo. {astronomer:live hold} Levantó sus prismáticos. Allí estaba la Tierra, grande y azul. La luz del sol rebota en la Tierra y llega hasta nosotros, dijo. Se llama luz cenicienta. {canvas:milkyway 12s} {robot:face happy} Robot saludó a la Tierra. ¡Gracias por la luz! {pilot:enter} {pilot:face happy} Piloto también saludó. Y, por si la Tierra quería verlos a ellos, {beacon:live hold} Robot volvió a encender la baliza.

click.prompt: a single chunky switch clicking off, small and clean
